fusions.name: Shrieking Arrow
fusions.desc: Fires a screaming arrow that deals 12 resonating damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Dusk Flock
fusions.desc: Looses 3 dark arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 dark damage; 20% of the damage comes back to you as healing over 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Flit Through Dark
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Night-Sighted
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage.
